verdict.rationale: Mixpanel supports large-scale data operations via its Raw Event Export API (bulk export of millions of events), warehouse connectors (bulk sync from/to warehouses), and JQL for custom queries across large event sets, which could support AI-driven bulk analysis. However, there is no evidence of bulk write/update/delete operations (e.g., batch API for events, cohorts, or dashboards) exposed to an AI agent — the MCP server only lists single-item actions like 'Create-Dashboard'. missing for 10: explicit bulk write/mutate APIs (batch create/update/delete), MCP tool support for operating on many items in one call, and independent confirmation of bulk operation reliability.
